description: This file defines Redux state management for 'cards' in a web application, including actions, selectors, and state structure related to card data, templates, sorting, filtering, and asynchronous data refresh.

methods.name: limitCard
methods.description: Limits a card based on whether it is a board template and the provided timestamp, marking it as limited if conditions are met.

methods.name: titleOrCreatedOrder
methods.description: Determines order between two cards based on title or creation date.

methods.name: manualOrder
methods.description: Determines order of two cards based on a manual card order in the active view.

methods.name: sortCards
methods.description: Sorts an array of cards based on view's sort options, including title, properties, and custom logic.

methods.name: searchFilterCards
methods.description: Filters cards based on search text matching card title or properties.
